step: B-S11 (R-5): demo/stories/manifest.ts 1,098 → 303 lines. The eleven category blocks move to manifest/categories/<id>.ts (one file per category, the rows verbatim), the Story/Category vocabulary to manifest/types.ts, the row factory s() to manifest/row.ts; the manifest keeps the globs, the background and landing maps, the row resolver, the depth ladder, the assembly, the act order and the lookups. The pi lane re-sources its scenes from the category files the manifest imports.
